mechanisms_tested.boundary: monthly BNR policy rate -> monthly RON new-business household/NPISH house-purchase lending rate
mechanisms_tested.parameter_provenance: beta fitted only from observations preceding each structural-selection origin; final frozen beta fitted through 2025-01 before holdout
mechanisms_tested.baseline_result: Structural-selection RMSE 0.168695 vs persistence 0.183521; final holdout candidate RMSE 0.057271 equals persistence 0.057271 because there were zero policy-rate changes.
mechanisms_tested.sensitivity: ±10% beta has no effect in final holdout because Δpolicy=0 throughout the holdout; this is non-informative sensitivity, not evidence of robustness.
mechanisms_tested.time_respecting_validation: 25 expanding-origin selection months followed by one first-and-only 10-month fresh holdout.
mechanisms_tested.rejection_criteria_result: Fails preregistered final RMSE-improvement gate versus persistence.
mechanisms_tested.reason: Evidence and structural selection support a parsimonious response form, but the fresh evaluation window contains no policy-rate event and therefore cannot independently discriminate pass-through from persistence.

mechanisms_tested.boundary: monthly BNR policy rate -> monthly RON NFC new-business lending rate with variable/initial fixation up to one year
mechanisms_tested.baseline_result: Best direct delta-policy candidate structural-selection RMSE 0.231593 vs persistence 0.216629; no preregistered form passes every selection gate.
mechanisms_tested.sensitivity: Final-holdout sensitivity not run because holdout opening was not authorized after selection failure.
mechanisms_tested.time_respecting_validation: 25 expanding-origin selection months; final holdout deliberately remains unopened.
mechanisms_tested.rejection_criteria_result: Fails structural-selection improvement gate before final evaluation.
mechanisms_tested.reason: The existence of monetary transmission is not rejected, but every tested parsimonious NFC form fails the predictive selection gate.

mechanisms_tested.boundary: MoF government debt portfolio effective-rate repricing
mechanisms_tested.parameter_provenance: No m estimated; no redemption ratio, strategic target or one auction yield is substituted for m.
mechanisms_tested.baseline_result: Not applicable: the boundary-matched inputs required to estimate the aggregate equation do not exist as one reconciled series.
mechanisms_tested.sensitivity: Not run because the parameter is not definitionally identified.
mechanisms_tested.time_respecting_validation: Not opened; empirical gate fails before estimation.
mechanisms_tested.rejection_criteria_result: Aggregate form cannot be calibrated without synthetic allocation across maturity, currency and fixed/floating-rate blocks.
mechanisms_tested.reason: Official data distinguish maturity and refixing and provide heterogeneous stock costs and issuance yields; an instrument-level repricing ledger is required before activation.

next_empirical_path: Preserve MIR observations from 2026-08 onward as a prospective confirmation holdout and do not revise the selected household delta-policy form using those observations before first formal confirmation.
Accumulate a fresh policy-rate easing/tightening episode so the confirmation holdout contains identifying driver variation.
Build a government repricing ledger by instrument, currency and fixed/floating status, with realized reset/maturity dates, repriced principal and matched old/new effective rates.
Only after one of these paths passes a newly preregistered validation gate may the behavioural reference-model gate be reconsidered.
